name: The Occident and American Jewish Advocate
description: Isaac Leeser's monthly, the first successful Jewish periodical in the United States, and a national clearing-house for congregational news.

name: The Asmonean
description: Edited by Robert Lyon; the first Jewish weekly in the United States. Isaac Mayer Wise wrote for it before founding his own paper.

name: The Israelite
description: Isaac Mayer Wise's English-language weekly, renamed The American Israelite in 1874; the principal organ of moderate Reform in the West.

name: Die Deborah
description: German-language companion to The Israelite, edited by Wise and aimed at immigrant readers and women.

name: Sinai
description: David Einhorn's German-language monthly of radical Reform, which also carried his attacks on slavery.

name: The Jewish Messenger
description: Traditionalist weekly edited by Samuel Myer Isaacs and later his sons; staunchly Unionist in the Civil War.

name: The Weekly Gleaner
description: First Jewish periodical on the Pacific coast, edited by Julius Eckman.
